profile.name: Berk Limoncu
profile.intro: I build ==software that has to work==. Lending systems for a bank, consumer apps on the App Store, and a thesis on when microservices are worth it.
profile.about: Full-stack developer working mostly with React, TypeScript, Node.js and Spring Boot. I've spent my time in fintech and healthcare, where reliability matters more than novelty, and I care a lot about a code review culture that's respectful and useful.
